extraction_notes: Fiscal deficit, revenue deficit, and primary deficit are reported as positive magnitudes. Revenue and Primary deficits are 0 as the state had a surplus. Debt % GSDP refers to Fiscal Liabilities % GSDP. Capital Outlay % GSDP was calculated from absolute figures of Capital Outlay (₹4,583 crore, Table 1.2) and GSDP (₹1,51,835 crore, Table 1.1), confirmed by cross-calculation using Capital expenditure/Aggregate expenditure (13.29%, Table 1.18) and Aggregate expenditure/GSDP (22.72%, Table 1.18). Interest % Revenue Receipts value (9.56%) is from Table 1.28 and Chart 1.20; the conclusion on page 64 states 13%. Audit paras 'raised_this_year' refers to excess expenditure cases for 2018-19 (Appendix 2.3). 'Outstanding_over_5_years' refers to misappropriation/loss/theft cases explicitly stated as 'more than five years old' (Page 16, Paragraph 3.4 and Page 87, Table 3.2). 'PAC_recommendations_pending' refers to excess expenditure cases from 2013-14 to 2017-18 (Appendix 2.2). 'Money_value_of_observations_crore' refers to excess expenditure for 2018-19 (Page 15, Executive Summary and Page 70, Paragraph 2.3.1).
